summary: First Community Bankshares filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting that Bearing Insurance Group, LLC completed its sale to BroadStreet Partners Group, LLC. The registrant owned 11 units of Bearing and expects a pre-tax gain of approximately $10 million. No transaction terms, price per share, premium, or consideration were disclosed. The filing is a routine informational item about a portfolio investment realization, not a special situation corporate event. What to watch: none; this is not a risk-arb opportunity.
